title: Gambar Studio Mak Ayah
mood: understanding your father's face forty years late
subject: a 1978 studio portrait of your parents in front of a blue curtain
caption: Malay psychedelic pop in the late-1960s to 1970s croon style. Combo organ holding swirling chords, electric guitar with a light fuzz tone playing melodic fills through tape echo, warm round bass, a drum kit played with brushes and light sticks, occasional vibraphone accents. Warm tape-saturated sound, slightly woozy and wide, deliberately vintage rather than clean. Crooned male baritone, smooth and unhurried, with a gentle vibrato on line endings. 96 BPM, E flat major. Understanding your father's face forty years too late. No modern drums, no synth pad, no autotune, no power-ballad climax, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - organ and fuzz guitar]

[Verse 1]
Gambar studio, tahun tujuh puluh lapan, latar langsir biru
Mak pakai kebaya, ayah pakai kemeja, rambut ayah masih penuh
Dua-dua tak senyum, sebab jurugambar suruh diam
Diam lama sangat, sampai gambar tu jadi muka mereka untuk aku

[Chorus]
Aku cari diri aku dalam gambar tu
Aku belum ada lagi, aku cuma satu rancangan
Mak dah tahu nama aku masa tu
Dia cerita lepas tu, dia simpan dalam kepala

[Verse 2]
Bingkai tu dah retak, kaca dia dah kuning
Aku bawa ke kedai, orang tu kata boleh baiki
Aku tak baiki, aku beli bingkai lain
Retak tu aku nak simpan, tu pun sejarah

[Chorus]
Aku cari diri aku dalam gambar tu
Aku belum ada lagi, aku cuma satu rancangan
Mak dah tahu nama aku masa tu
Dan sekarang aku tahu kenapa ayah tak senyum, dia takut

[Outro - organ, fading]
Langsir biru tu
Mak masih simpan
